title: Kepler to Seussius, 15 July 1622
author: Johannes Kepler
summary: Kepler thanks Seussius for Philipp Müller's theses against the astrologer Paul Nagel, recalls his own pseudonymous attack on the end-of-the-world prophets and his quarrel with Robert Fludd, and comments on Müller's theses on the cross in Cygnus, the new star and Johann Arndt.

notes.note: The Ides of July: 15 July 1622. Von Dyck's list of the collection gives 1 July.
Robert Fludd, whose attack on the appendix to Kepler's *Harmonices mundi* (1619) Kepler answered in his *Pro suo opere Harmonices mundi apologia* (1622).
Proverbial: the Sicilian town of Camarina drained its marsh against an oracle's advice and fell to its enemies through the dry ground. To move Camarina is to stir up trouble better left alone.
